instruction: A wide sculptural arm cuff bracelet formed from a rippling ribbon of molten mirror-chrome. Its fluid surface warps and reflects its surroundings in stretched silver and blue tones, twisting into an open teardrop shape. Seamless drips and bulges along the band make it look like frozen liquid metal captured mid-flow.
